name: Shiogama (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Shiogama city emblem in white: a ring with two hooked ends enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shiogama, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1942.

features.role: Shiogama city emblem — a ring with two hooked ends enclosing a disc
